WITH patient_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_all
    FROM patient_avgs
),
first_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        p.ratio,
        p.ratio - o.avg_ratio_all as above_overall
    FROM patient_avgs p
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio_all
),
second_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_kept
    FROM first_filtered
),
second_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        f.ratio,
        f.above_overall,
        f.ratio - s.avg_ratio_kept as above_second_avg
    FROM first_filtered f
    CROSS JOIN second_avg s
    WHERE f.ratio > s.avg_ratio_kept
)
SELECT 
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
    AVG(above_overall) as avg_above_overall,
    AVG(above_second_avg) as avg_above_second_avg
FROM second_filtered
